channel.aux_arming.text: Arm the craft, default is to also activate Idle-up

channel.aux_buzzer_enable.text: Turn on the buzzer from a switch, useful to find a lost craft

channel.aux_fpv_switch.text: Vtx Pit mode on a switch. If you are not using this leave as ON

channel.aux_horizon.text: Self levelling up to a specific angle then Acro on both Roll and Pitch, requires Level mode active

channel.aux_idle_up.text: Ensures props never stop spinning, similar to airmode, default is to use the same channel as ARM

channel.aux_levelmode.text: Accelerometer data is used to self level, needed for Racemode and Horizon

channel.aux_motor_test.text: Activate the motor test function, useful to check individual motors in the field

channel.aux_osd_profile.text: Allows for a second OSD screen with different or no elements on a switch

channel.aux_prearm.text: Allows for a separate AUX channel to be set as a safety for arming, the set AUX should be ON before the ARM switch is activated. If not used leave this as ON

channel.aux_racemode.text: Uses self levelling only on the roll axis, acro on pitch, requires Level mode active

channel.aux_rate_profile.text: Switch between rate profile 1 and 2 in flight

channel.aux_rssi.text: For fcs that can send rssi on a channel

channel.aux_stick_boost_profile.text: Switch between the two stick boost profiles, AUX Off and AUX On

channel.aux_turtle.text: Set this to ON and the fc will detect when landed inverted and activate Turtle when ARM is active, optional to set to an Aux switch

filter.dterm_1_freq.text: Cutoff frequency of the first D-term lowpass in Hz, lower filters more noise but adds delay

filter.dterm_1_type.text: Filter type for the first D-term lowpass, PT1 is the lightest, PT3 the strongest. None disables this pass

filter.dterm_2_freq.text: Cutoff frequency of the second D-term lowpass in Hz, lower filters more noise but adds delay

filter.dterm_2_type.text: Filter type for the second D-term lowpass, PT1 is the lightest, PT3 the strongest. None disables this pass

filter.dterm_dynamic_enable.text: Enable a dynamic D-term filtercut, you almost always want to leave this ON

filter.dterm_dynamic_type.text: Enable a dynamic D-term filtercut, you almost always want to use at least a pt1

filter.dterm_dynamic_max.text: Dynamic D-term cutoff in Hz at full throttle

filter.dterm_dynamic_min.text: Dynamic D-term cutoff in Hz at zero throttle, the cutoff rises towards Dynamic Max as throttle increases

filter.gyro_1_freq.text: Cutoff frequency of the first gyro lowpass in Hz, lower filters more noise but adds delay

filter.gyro_1_type.text: Filter type for the first gyro lowpass, PT1 is the lightest, PT3 the strongest. None disables this pass

filter.gyro_2_freq.text: Cutoff frequency of the second gyro lowpass in Hz, lower filters more noise but adds delay

filter.gyro_2_type.text: Filter type for the second gyro lowpass, PT1 is the lightest, PT3 the strongest. None disables this pass

filter.gyro_dynamic_notch_enable.text: Tracks noise peaks and inserts notch filters at these frequencies

filter.settings.text: The default filter setting are designed to be safe, before making adjustments refer to the wiki

flash.file-branch.text: Development branch to flash a hex from

flash.file-pull-request.text: Pull request to flash a hex from

flash.file-release.text: The default selection is the latest `stable` release, dev versions are available as testers

flash.file-commit.text: The latest commit hash on the selected branch

flash.file-remote.text: Targets are named `board_name.motor_type` choose serial if your rx is separate and attatched to a uart. If you don't see your fc listed exactly then don't flash, please ask for a target in our Discord server

flash.reset.text: Pressing the `Reset To Bootloader` button should force the fc into DFU mode for flashing, if it doesn't work use the button on the fc while connecting USB

flash.source.text: If you compile your own hex select `local` and choose it in the next box

motor.digital_idle.text: Adjust in small ammounts if needed to achieve smooth idle

motor.dshot_time.text: On some fcs this might need set to 300 to avoid failloops, Default 600

motor.flip_gyro.text: Rotate the gyro 180° when the fc is mounted upside down, combine with gyro orientation until the preview model moves correctly

motor.gyro_orientation.text: Change this if the fc is mounted in a non standard way, use with the flip-gyro option until the preview model moves correctly

motor.motor_limit.text: Set a cap on the maximum throttle

motor.test.text: Connect a lipo, PROPS OFF, use sliders to confirm motor operation and direction

motor.throttle_boost.text: Experimental, use with caution, can rob motors of power if set too high

motor.torque_boost.text: A very experimental feature for more advanced use

motor.turtle_throttle_percent.text: For whoops set to 100% larger craft start at 10% and increase by 10 to suit needs

motor_pins.text: Use this section to change motor positions, useful when using an fc in non standard configuration

osd.elements.text: Select and position OSD elements, callsign must use upper case

osd.font.text: A choice of fonts are available, select and upload. You can also upload your own custom boot logo as long as it a 288x72 Black/White/Transparent PNG

pid.angle_strength.text: Angle Strength adjusts how your craft responds to external forces from bumps to stick inputs

pid.preset.text: Select by thrust to weight ratio or props size, these presets give a safe starting point to further tune if needed

pid.profile.text: You can have 2 different sets of pids loaded in 2 profiles

pid.stick_profile.text: Allows for adjustment to stick feel

pid.tda_active.text: As higher throttle levels are reached D-term gain is reduced allowing the D-term notch filter to work safely

pid.tda_breakpoint.text: Throttle percentage before TDA starts to act

pid.tda_percent.text: Percentage reduction of D-term at max throttle

rate.level_max_angle.text: Increase to give a higher velocity for racing, combined with high camera angle, to a max of 90

rate.low_rate_mulitplier.text: Rates are multiplied by this value while the high rates switch is off, 1.0 keeps them unchanged

rate.mode.text: Silverware, Betaflight and Actual rates option

rate.sticks_deadband.text: If your radio has `jitter` on Pitch/Roll stick center raising this a little can help

rate.throttle_expo.text: Adding some expo will soften the stick feel around the set `Throttle Mid`

rate.throttle_mid.text: Can be set to about where your `hover point` is

receiver.bind_saved.text: Once you have bind and issued stick gesture up,up,up followed by down,down,down on Pitch this will show YES

receiver.channel_mapping.text: Quicksilver default is AETR the other option is TAER

receiver.lqi_source.text: Select the source for your rssi/lqi OSD display. Direct is best for ELRS, others can use Packet-Rate

receiver.protocol.text: Serial or spi connected rx will be detected automatically here

serial.digital_vtx.text: MSP serial port for digital systems like HDZero, DJI WTF and Walksnail. HDZero requires TX and RX connected to use msp, define the UART here

serial.rx.text: Enter the UART number the serial RX is connected to (for spi RX leave as NONE)

serial.smart_audio.text: Enter the UART the VTX TX line is connected to

serial.gps.text: Enter the UART the GPS TX line is connected to

serial_passthrough.text: Can be used to flash serial receivers via passthrough, set correct uart and Start

voltage.actual_battery_voltage.text: Default is 4.2V, set to whatever value you get from a multimeter or lipo tester for a full lipo.

voltage.vbat_scale.text: Use the value provided by the FC manufacturer

voltage.ibat_scale.text: Use the value provided by the FC manufacturer

voltage.lipo_cell_count.text: Enter the number of cells, leave at 0 to use autodetect

voltage.pid_voltage_compensation.text: Adjusts the pids to compensate for lipo voltage drop, default ON

voltage.reported_telemetry_voltage.text: Set to the value received by your tx or in the OSD view with a full lipo

voltage.vbattlow.text: Set the desired voltage to trigger a warning, single cell voltage is used Default 3.3V (uses Fuel gauge volts by default)

voltage.use_filtered_voltage_for_warning.text: Use filtered voltage instead Fuel gauge volts for Warnings

rover.servo_pwm_hz.text: PWM frequency for the steering servo output in Hz. Standard servos typically use 50Hz.

rover.reversible.text: Enable bidirectional motor output. Allows the drive motor to run in reverse using the throttle reverse limit.

motor.test_master.text: Sets all unidirectional test outputs to the same value, from 0 to 50%. On a wing, PWM outputs are excluded, including PWM throttle outputs. It has no effect on an all-PWM wing. The displayed value is the highest included output value.

vtx.band.text: Frequency band used by the video transmitter. Band and Channel together select the transmit frequency.

vtx.channel.text: Channel within the selected VTX band. Match the resulting frequency on your video receiver.

vtx.detected.text: Protocol and frequency reported by the connected VTX. These are the detected values, which may differ from the requested settings until they are applied.

vtx.pit_mode.text: Requests the VTX low-power pit mode for setup near other pilots. Availability and behavior depend on the video transmitter.

vtx.power_level.text: Requested VTX transmit power level. Available levels and their labels come from the configured or detected power table.

vtx.protocol.text: Control protocol used by the connected video transmitter. Select the protocol supported by your VTX and configure its serial port in Serial settings.

wing.autolaunch.accel_threshold.text: Forward acceleration needed to detect a throw, in g. Launch detection can also come from GPS speed.

wing.autolaunch.detect_time_ms.text: How long a launch detection condition must remain true before the throw is accepted. A longer time rejects brief spikes.

wing.autolaunch.finish_ms.text: Time to blend launch throttle and pitch back toward pilot control when the climb ends. Roll or pitch movement beyond Stick Deadband ends this ramp early.

wing.autolaunch.idle_delay_ms.text: Delay after raising throttle with autolaunch armed, before ramping to Idle Throttle and waiting for the throw.

wing.autolaunch.idle_throttle.text: Motor throttle while waiting for a throw and during the motor delay. A nonzero value can spin the motor before launch; 0 keeps it stopped.

wing.autolaunch.max_altitude.text: GPS altitude gain above the launch reference that ends the climb and starts the finish ramp. Requires GPS lock and a valid launch altitude reference. 0 disables this exit condition.

wing.autolaunch.min_time_ms.text: Minimum time from launch detection before roll or pitch stick movement can cancel the launch. Does not prevent disarming or switching autolaunch off.

wing.autolaunch.motor_delay_ms.text: Delay before ramping to Launch Throttle after the throw is released. The motor stays at Idle Throttle during this delay.

wing.autolaunch.pitch_angle.text: Target pitch attitude during autolaunch, in degrees. Positive values command a nose-up climb.

wing.autolaunch.spinup_ms.text: Time to ramp from Idle Throttle to Launch Throttle after the motor delay.

wing.autolaunch.stick_deadband.text: Roll or pitch stick movement from center needed to cancel autolaunch after Min Launch Time, as a percentage of stick travel. During the finish ramp, this movement ends the handover immediately.

wing.autolaunch.throttle.text: Motor throttle used during the launch climb, as a percentage of full throttle.

wing.autolaunch.timeout_ms.text: Duration of the launch climb after motor spinup, before the finish ramp begins. Reaching Max Launch Altitude can end the climb sooner.

wing.autolaunch.velocity_threshold.text: GPS ground speed needed to detect launch, in m/s. Requires GPS lock and a level to nose-up attitude. Acceleration can detect a throw without GPS.

channel.aux_autotrim.text: Capture wing control-surface trim during steady flight. Keep Autotrim enabled through landing and disarming so the captured trim can be saved. Switching it off before saving cancels the capture and restores the previous trim.

channel.aux_autolaunch.text: Enable assisted wing launch before arming. Uses the detection, throttle, pitch and handover settings in Wing Settings. Switching it off cancels autolaunch; disarm before starting another launch.

channel.aux_acromode.text: Enable gyro-stabilized rate control on a wing. Sticks command rotation rates rather than a self-leveling attitude. Acro mode takes priority over Level mode.
